/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import csv, io, os
from pathlib import Path
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
key=Path(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read_text().strip()
gi=GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org',key=key)
ids={'iron_depleted':'f9cad7b01a472135a1473807c0e345cf','innate_media':'f9cad7b01a47213515f9ab1c66783cb9'}
sets={}
for label,did in ids.items():
    resp=gi.make_get_request(gi.datasets._make_url(did)+'/display')
    resp.raise_for_status()
    rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(resp.text),delimiter='\\t'))
    sig={r['pathway_id'] for r in rows if float(r['adjusted_p_value']) < 0.05}
    sets[label]=sig
    print(label,len(sig),','.join(sorted(sig)))
exclusive=sets['iron_depleted']-sets['innate_media']
print('exclusive_count',len(exclusive))
print('exclusive_ids',','.join(sorted(exclusive)))
PY
if [ -d codex_output ]; then rg --files codex_output; else echo 'NO_CODEX_OUTPUT_DIR'; fi"
